entries.35ad731f4c6ec176: This is the group's only reportable segment. Five companies, Maruetsu, Kasumi, Maxvalu Kanto, Inageya and Seibu, operate supermarkets that sell mainly food products along with daily-use goods and clothing, and subsidiaries that process fresh food and manufacture and procure food products support the stores. As of February 28, 2026, the group had 665 stores. Additionally, on March 1, 2026, Maxvalu Kanto integrated Daiei's Kanto business and AEON Market, and changed its name to AEON Foodstyle.
